c897a78f64.q: What was the criminal charge against Virginia State Senator Louise Lucas?
c897a78f64.a: Senator Louise Lucas, the president pro tempore of the Virginia State Senate, was indicted on October 14th on five counts related to a large-scale RICO drug trafficking and money laundering conspiracy. Six members of her family, including her daughters Lisa Lucas Burke and Teresa Lucas Lamb, were also indicted. The charges stemmed from her licensed cannabis business and resulted in the 82-year-old great-grandmother having her whole family indicted on money laundering and racketeering charges.
